item.title: Correction · One Mission Bay: The map caveat and notes called blklot 8715007 a current common-area/master lot with no address. DataSF Parcels shows it as a retired parcel (mapped 2014-02-11, dropped 2016-11-16) whose last Assessor roll is 2017 with the address 110 Channel St, and no active lot carries it as its map block-lot, so the caveat and a dated note now say the map shape includes a superseded boundary (the shape itself was not changed). The notes also now say that '13 stories', a '6-story perimeter building', CIM Group as developer and Arquitectonica as architect appear in no cited source (Compass says 16 stories, OpenStreetMap 17, Strada 'partnered with the buyer'). The notes now cite Strada's 350 units and 20,000 sq ft of retail and the Compass pool and concierge, dropping unit sizes and other amenities. The June 2018 completion milestone now reads 2018, and the November 2016 topping-out milestone (cited only to Business Wire's home page; the release could not be read) was removed. The map's source description now mentions that the shape joins in the retired parcel's boundary.

item.title: Milestone · One Mission Bay: DBI recorded the new-construction permits for both One Mission Bay buildings (201408133766 at 110 Channel St, 152 units; 201408133775 at 1000 3rd St, 198 units) as completed. This is the permits' closure date, not an opening or completion date. (Nov 20, 2020)
